        "originalContents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\nimport { Index } from '@upstash/search';\n\n// Initialize Upstash Search client\nconst searchIndex = new Index({\n  url: process.env.UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL!,\n  token: process.env.UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN!,\n});\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;\n    const query = searchParams.get('q');\n    const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');\n    const docType = searchParams.get('type');\n    const tags = searchParams.get('tags')?.split(',');\n\n    if (!query) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ \n        error: 'Query parameter is required' \n      }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Build filter object if needed\n    const filter: any = {};\n    if (docType) {\n      filter.doc_type = docType;\n    }\n    if (tags \u0026\u0026 tags.length \u003e 0) {\n      filter.tags = { $in: tags };\n    }\n\n    // Search documents\n    const results = await searchIndex.query({\n      q: query,\n      topK: limit,\n      ...(Object.keys(filter).length \u003e 0 \u0026\u0026 { filter }),\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      query,\n      results: results.hits,\n      total: results.count,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Search error:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ \n      error: 'Failed to search documents',\n      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n    }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nKnowledge Base Service\nHandles document indexing, entity extraction, and search synchronization\nIntegrates with Upstash Search and Xata for comprehensive data management\nDate: June 20, 2025\nUpdated: June 25, 2025\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport json\nimport hashlib\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Optional, Dict, Any\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom .knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD\nfrom .sync_to_upstash_search_integrated import IntegratedUpstashSyncer\nfrom .terminal_display import TerminalDisplay\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\ndisplay = TerminalDisplay()\n\n\nclass KnowledgeBaseService:\n    \"\"\"Knowledge base service that handles document indexing and search synchronization\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.kb_crud = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()\n        self.search_syncer = None\n        self._init_search_syncer()\n\n    def _init_search_syncer(self):\n        \"\"\"Initialize Upstash Search syncer if credentials available\"\"\"\n        search_url = os.getenv(\"UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL\")\n        search_token = os.getenv(\"UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN\")\n\n        if search_url and search_token:\n            try:\n                self.search_syncer = IntegratedUpstashSyncer(\n                    search_url, search_token)\n                logger.info(\"Upstash Search integration enabled\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"Failed to initialize Upstash Search: {e}\")\n                self.search_syncer = None\n        else:\n            logger.info(\n                \"Upstash Search credentials not found, skipping Search integration\")",

        "originalContents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nKnowledge Base Service\nHandles document indexing, entity extraction, and search synchronization\nIntegrates with Upstash Search and Xata for comprehensive data management\nDate: June 20, 2025\nUpdated: June 25, 2025\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport json\nimport hashlib\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Optional, Dict, Any\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom .knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD\nfrom .sync_to_upstash_search_integrated import IntegratedUpstashSyncer\nfrom .terminal_display import TerminalDisplay\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\ndisplay = TerminalDisplay()\n\n\nclass KnowledgeBaseService:\n    \"\"\"Knowledge base service that handles document indexing and search synchronization\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.kb_crud = KnowledgeBaseCRUD()\n        self.search_syncer = None\n        self._init_search_syncer()\n\n    def _init_search_syncer(self):\n        \"\"\"Initialize Upstash Search syncer if credentials available\"\"\"\n        search_url = os.getenv(\"UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL\")\n        search_token = os.getenv(\"UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN\")\n\n        if search_url and search_token:\n            try:\n                self.search_syncer = IntegratedUpstashSyncer(\n                    search_url, search_token)\n                logger.info(\"Upstash Search integration enabled\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"Failed to initialize Upstash Search: {e}\")\n                self.search_syncer = None\n        else:\n            logger.info(\n                \"Upstash Search credentials not found, skipping Search integration\")",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSync local disclosure-rag knowledge base to Upstash Search\nUses the new Upstash Search service for better document handling\nDate: June 20, 2025\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport json\nimport requests\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional\nimport logging\nfrom knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD, Document\n\n# Configure logging\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nclass UpstashSearchSyncer:\n    \"\"\"Sync local knowledge base to Upstash Search for cloud access\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, url: str, token: str, kb_path: str = None):\n        self.kb_crud = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(kb_path)\n        self.base_url = url.rstrip('/')\n        self.headers = {\n            \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {token}\",\n            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"\n        }\n        self.sync_state_file = Path(self.kb_crud.metadata_path) / \"upstash_search_sync_state.json\"\n        self.sync_state = self._load_sync_state()\n        \n    def _load_sync_state(self) -\u003e Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Load sync state from disk\"\"\"\n        if self.sync_state_file.exists():\n            with open(self.sync_state_file, 'r') as f:\n                return json.load(f)\n        return {\n            \"last_sync\": None,\n            \"synced_documents\": {},\n            \"total_synced\": 0\n        }\n    \n    def _save_sync_state(self):\n        \"\"\"Save sync state to disk\"\"\"\n        with open(self.sync_state_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(self.sync_state, f, indent=2)",

        "originalContents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSync local disclosure-rag knowledge base to Upstash Search\nUses the new Upstash Search service for better document handling\nDate: June 20, 2025\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport json\nimport requests\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional\nimport logging\nfrom knowledge_base_crud import KnowledgeBaseCRUD, Document\n\n# Configure logging\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nclass UpstashSearchSyncer:\n    \"\"\"Sync local knowledge base to Upstash Search for cloud access\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, url: str, token: str, kb_path: str = None):\n        self.kb_crud = KnowledgeBaseCRUD(kb_path)\n        self.base_url = url.rstrip('/')\n        self.headers = {\n            \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {token}\",\n            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"\n        }\n        self.sync_state_file = Path(self.kb_crud.metadata_path) / \"upstash_search_sync_state.json\"\n        self.sync_state = self._load_sync_state()\n        \n    def _load_sync_state(self) -\u003e Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Load sync state from disk\"\"\"\n        if self.sync_state_file.exists():\n            with open(self.sync_state_file, 'r') as f:\n                return json.load(f)\n        return {\n            \"last_sync\": None,\n            \"synced_documents\": {},\n            \"total_synced\": 0\n        }\n    \n    def _save_sync_state(self):\n        \"\"\"Save sync state to disk\"\"\"\n        with open(self.sync_state_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(self.sync_state, f, indent=2)",

        "contents": "import { executeDatabaseTableQuery } from \"@/db/xata/db/search-operations\"\nimport { xata } from \"@db/xata/client\"\n\nexport const searchDatabase = async ( { table, searchTerms, searchFields, limit = 3, sortBy, sortOrder, dateRange }: any ) =\u003e {\n  if (!searchTerms?.length) return []\n\n  try {\n    // Use Xata's native search API for better relevancy scoring and reasoning\n    const searchQuery = searchTerms.join(' ')\n    \n    console.log(&#96;🔍 Searching ${table} for: \"${searchQuery}\"&#96;)\n    \n    // Use Xata's search with relevancy scoring and highlighting\n    const searchResults = await xata.search.all(searchQuery, {\n      tables: [\n        {\n          table: table,\n          target: searchFields || ['name', 'title', 'description', 'summary'], // Default search fields\n          boosters: [\n            // Boost more recent records\n            {\n              dateBooster: {\n                column: 'xata.createdAt',\n                decay: 0.3,\n                scale: '365d', // Boost records from last year\n                factor: 2\n              }\n            }\n          ]\n        }\n      ],\n      page: {\n        size: limit,\n        offset: 0\n      },\n      fuzziness: 1, // Allow typo tolerance\n      highlight: {\n        enabled: true\n      }\n    })\n\n    console.log(&#96;📊 Xata search results:&#96;, {\n      totalCount: searchResults.totalCount,\n      recordCount: searchResults.records?.length || 0,\n      searchQuery\n    })",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\nimport { Index } from '@upstash/search';\n\n// Initialize Upstash Search client\nconst searchIndex = new Index({\n  url: process.env.UPSTASH_SEARCH_URL!,\n  token: process.env.UPSTASH_SEARCH_TOKEN!,\n});\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;\n    const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');\n    const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');\n    const docType = searchParams.get('type');\n    const sortBy = searchParams.get('sort') || 'updated_at';\n    const order = searchParams.get('order') || 'desc';\n\n    // For browsing, we use a wildcard query to get all documents\n    const filter: any = {};\n    if (docType) {\n      filter.doc_type = docType;\n    }\n\n    // Calculate offset for pagination\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    // Browse all documents (using wildcard)\n    const results = await searchIndex.query({\n      q: '*',  // Wildcard to match all\n      topK: limit,\n      offset,\n      ...(Object.keys(filter).length \u003e 0 \u0026\u0026 { filter }),\n    });\n\n    // Get total count for pagination\n    const totalResults = await searchIndex.info();\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      documents: results.hits,\n      pagination: {\n        page,\n        limit,\n        total: totalResults.numDocuments || 0,\n        totalPages: Math.ceil((totalResults.numDocuments || 0) / limit),\n      },\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Browse error:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ \n      error: 'Failed to browse documents',\n      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n    }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { xata } from \"../client\";\n\nexport const searchXata = async ({\n\tquery,\n\tid,\n\ttable,\n}: {\n\tquery: string;\n\tid?: string | null;\n\ttable?: string | null;\n}) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif (!query) {\n\t\t\treturn { success: false, error: \"Query is required\" };\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlet searchResults;\n\n\t\tif (table \u0026\u0026 id) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table and record\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.db[table].search(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else if (table) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\ttables: [{ table }],\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t// Global search across all tables\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: true,\n\t\t\tsearchResults: searchResults.records || searchResults,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Search error:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: false,\n\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t};\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function searchMindmapsByContent(\n\tquery: string,\n\tlimit = 10,\n): Promise\u003cMindmapsRecord[]\u003e {\n\t// This is a simplified approach - in a real implementation you might parse\n\t// the JSON content and perform a more targeted search on specific fields\n\t// For now, we'll rely on Xata's vector search if embeddings are available\n\n\t// Try vector search first if the query can be embedded\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst results = await xata.db.mindmaps\n\t\t\t.vectorSearch(\"embedding\", query, { size: limit })\n\t\t\t.getAll();\n\n\t\tif (results.length \u003e 0) {\n\t\t\treturn results;\n\t\t}\n\t} catch (e) {\n\t\t// Fall back to regular search if vector search fails\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Vector search failed:\", e);\n\t}\n\n\t// Fall back to a basic text search on the JSON field\n\t// Note: This might not be very effective depending on how Xata indexes JSON fields\n\tconst textResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\ttables: [{ table: \"mindmaps\" }],\n\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\tlimit,\n\t});\n\n\treturn textResults.records as MindmapsRecord[];\n}",

        "contents": "class PostgreSQLBackend(BackendInterface):\n\n    \n    ...\n\n    \n    async def search(self, \n                    query: str, \n                    top_k: int = 5,\n                    threshold: Optional[float] = None) -\u003e List[SearchResult]:\n        \"\"\"Search for documents using pgvector similarity\"\"\"\n        try:\n            # Generate query embedding\n            query_embedding = self.model.encode([query], convert_to_numpy=True)[0]\n            \n            # Perform vector similarity search\n            async with self.pool.acquire() as conn:\n                rows = await conn.fetch(f\"\"\"\n                    SELECT id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at,\n                           embedding \u003c-\u003e $1 as distance\n                    FROM {self.table_name}\n                    ORDER BY embedding \u003c-\u003e $1\n                    LIMIT $2\n                \"\"\", query_embedding.tolist(), top_k)\n            \n            # Convert to SearchResult objects\n            results = []\n            for rank, row in enumerate(rows):\n                distance = float(row['distance'])\n                similarity = 1 / (1 + distance)\n                \n                if threshold and similarity \u003c threshold:\n                    continue\n                \n                document = self._document_from_row(row)\n                results.append(SearchResult(\n                    document=document,\n                    score=similarity,\n                    distance=distance,\n                    rank=rank + 1\n                ))\n            \n            # Update stats\n            self.stats['searches'] += 1\n            self.stats['last_operation'] = datetime.now().isoformat()\n            \n            return results\n            \n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"Error searching PostgreSQL: {e}\")\n            return []",

        "originalContents": "\n    \n    async def search(self, \n                    query: str, \n                    top_k: int = 5,\n                    threshold: Optional[float] = None) -\u003e List[SearchResult]:\n        \"\"\"Search for documents using pgvector similarity\"\"\"\n        try:\n            # Generate query embedding\n            query_embedding = self.model.encode([query], convert_to_numpy=True)[0]\n            \n            # Perform vector similarity search\n            async with self.pool.acquire() as conn:\n                rows = await conn.fetch(f\"\"\"\n                    SELECT id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at, updated_at,\n                           embedding \u003c-\u003e $1 as distance\n                    FROM {self.table_name}\n                    ORDER BY embedding \u003c-\u003e $1\n                    LIMIT $2\n                \"\"\", query_embedding.tolist(), top_k)\n            \n            # Convert to SearchResult objects\n            results = []\n            for rank, row in enumerate(rows):\n                distance = float(row['distance'])\n                similarity = 1 / (1 + distance)\n                \n                if threshold and similarity \u003c threshold:\n                    continue\n                \n                document = self._document_from_row(row)\n                results.append(SearchResult(\n                    document=document,\n                    score=similarity,\n                    distance=distance,\n                    rank=rank + 1\n                ))\n            \n            # Update stats\n            self.stats['searches'] += 1\n            self.stats['last_operation'] = datetime.now().isoformat()\n            \n            return results\n            \n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"Error searching PostgreSQL: {e}\")\n            return []",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Performs vector search on testimonies using embedding\n * @param embedding The vector embedding to search with\n * @param options Optional search configuration\n * @returns Array of matching testimony records\n */\nexport async function semanticSearchTestimonies(\n\tembedding: number[],\n\toptions?: {\n\t\tmaxResults?: number\n\t\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n\t},\n): Promise\u003cTestimoniesRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate input\n\t\tif ( !embedding || !Array.isArray( embedding ) || embedding.length !== 1536 ) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Valid embedding vector with 1536 dimensions is required\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_EMBEDDING\",\n\t\t\t\t\"semanticSearchTestimonies\",\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst searchOptions = {\n\t\t\tmaxResults: options?.maxResults || 10,\n\t\t\tfilter: options?.filter,\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst results = await xata.db.testimonies.vectorSearch(\n\t\t\t\"embedding\",\n\t\t\tembedding,\n\t\t\tsearchOptions,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\treturn results.records as TestimoniesRecord[]\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error in semantic search of testimonies:\", error )\n\n\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed in semantic search: ${( error as Error ).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"VECTOR_SEARCH_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"semanticSearchTestimonies\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Xata Reasoning Integration - Core Mindmap Feature\n\n## 🎯 Overview\n\nThis document details the **core functionality** of the UFO/UAP research platform: how Prometheus AI leverages Xata's built-in reasoning capabilities to create intelligent mindmap connections with meaningful edge annotations.\n\n**Key Feature**: When a user selects an event, the system creates 3 contextually related child nodes with edges that display **Prometheus' reasoning** for why each connection was made.\n\n## 🔄 Complete Data Flow\n\n### 1. User Interaction\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nUser selects event → User input node created → Prometheus AI activated\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Prometheus Analysis Pipeline\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nPrometheus receives query\n    ↓ \nFile search (vector store)\n    ↓\nExtract entities from results  \n    ↓\nCall searchDatabase() with entities\n    ↓\nReceive Xata records + built-in reasoning\n    ↓\nAnalyze records with AI context\n    ↓\nReturn structured response with reasoning\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Mindmap Visualization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nRecords + Reasoning → Child nodes created → Smart edges with annotations\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🛠️ Technical Implementation\n\n### Enhanced searchDatabase Function\n\n**File**: &#96;/src/services/ai/openai/tools/search-database.ts&#96;\n\n#### Xata SDK Integration\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Use Xata's native search API for built-in reasoning\nconst searchResults = await xata.search.all(searchQuery, {\n  tables: [\n    {\n      table: table,\n      target: searchFields || ['name', 'title', 'description', 'summary'],\n      boosters: [\n        {\n          dateBooster: {\n            column: 'xata.createdAt',\n            decay: 0.3,\n            scale: '365d',\n            factor: 2\n          }\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  page: { size: limit, offset: 0 },\n  fuzziness: 1, // Typo tolerance\n  highlight: { enabled: true }\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Built-in Reasoning Extraction\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Enhanced records with Xata's built-in reasoning\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Performs vector search on events using embedding\n * @param embedding The vector embedding to search with\n * @param options Optional search configuration\n * @returns Array of matching event records\n */\nexport async function semanticSearchEvents(\n\tembedding: number[],\n\toptions?: {\n\t\tmaxResults?: number\n\t\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n\t},\n): Promise\u003cEventsRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate input\n\t\tif ( !embedding || !Array.isArray( embedding ) || embedding.length !== 1536 ) {\n\t\t\tthrow createEventError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Valid embedding vector with 1536 dimensions is required\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_EMBEDDING\",\n\t\t\t\t\"semanticSearchEvents\",\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst searchOptions = {\n\t\t\tmaxResults: options?.maxResults || 10,\n\t\t\tfilter: options?.filter,\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst results = await xata.db.events.vectorSearch(\n\t\t\t\"embedding\",\n\t\t\tembedding,\n\t\t\tsearchOptions,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\treturn results.records as EventsRecord[]\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error in semantic search of events:\", error )\n\n\t\tthrow createEventError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed in semantic search: ${( error as Error ).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"VECTOR_SEARCH_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"semanticSearchEvents\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Performs vector search on events using embedding\n * @param embedding The vector embedding to search with\n * @param options Optional search configuration\n * @returns Array of matching event records\n */\nexport async function semanticSearchEvents(\n\tembedding: number[],\n\toptions?: {\n\t\tmaxResults?: number\n\t\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n\t},\n): Promise\u003cEventsRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate input\n\t\tif ( !embedding || !Array.isArray( embedding ) || embedding.length !== 1536 ) {\n\t\t\tthrow createEventError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Valid embedding vector with 1536 dimensions is required\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_EMBEDDING\",\n\t\t\t\t\"semanticSearchEvents\",\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst searchOptions = {\n\t\t\tmaxResults: options?.maxResults || 10,\n\t\t\tfilter: options?.filter,\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst results = await xata.db.events.vectorSearch(\n\t\t\t\"embedding\",\n\t\t\tembedding,\n\t\t\tsearchOptions,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\treturn results.records as EventsRecord[]\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error in semantic search of events:\", error )\n\n\t\tthrow createEventError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed in semantic search: ${( error as Error ).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"VECTOR_SEARCH_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"semanticSearchEvents\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class LocalVectorLibrary:\n\n    \n    ...\n\n    \n    def _vector_search(self, query: str, limit: int) -\u003e List[LocalDocument]:\n        \"\"\"Perform vector search\"\"\"\n        if self.vector_store[\"type\"] == \"chroma\":\n            try:\n                collection = self.vector_store[\"collection\"]\n                results = collection.query(\n                    query_texts=[query],\n                    n_results=min(limit, 10)\n                )\n                \n                documents = []\n                if results[\"ids\"]:\n                    for doc_id in results[\"ids\"][0]:\n                        doc = self.get_document(doc_id)\n                        if doc:\n                            documents.append(doc)\n                return documents\n                \n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Vector search failed: {e}\")\n        \n        # Fallback to simple text search\n        return self._simple_text_search(query, limit)\n    \n    def _simple_text_search(self, query: str, limit: int) -\u003e List[LocalDocument]:\n        \"\"\"Simple text-based search fallback\"\"\"\n        query_words = query.lower().split()\n        \n        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:\n            cursor = conn.cursor()\n            cursor.execute(\"SELECT doc_id FROM documents\")\n            doc_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]\n        \n        scored_docs = []\n        for doc_id in doc_ids:\n            doc = self.get_document(doc_id)\n            if doc:\n                content_lower = doc.content.lower()\n                score = sum(1 for word in query_words if word in content_lower)\n                if score \u003e 0:\n                    scored_docs.append((score, doc))\n        \n        # Sort by score and return top results\n        scored_docs.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)\n        return [doc for score, doc in scored_docs[:limit]]",
